plain_text:
Planting dune grass on the newly built artificial berm at Town

Neck Beach in Sandwich, Massachusetts. The beach has been

renourished and eroded several times. The U.S. Geological Survey

monitors conditions with quarterly light detection and ranging

(lidar) and photogrammetric surveys with drones.
